Definition: Nethanel, the name of ten Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Nethanel is a name worn by ten different Israelites, and the Bible keeps them apart by their fathers and their work. One is the prince of Issachar, one is David's brother, and one is a teacher Jehoshaphat sends into the cities of Judah to teach the law.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a shared name does not make a shared life: each Nethanel stands in his own place, and God uses each one there.
